items.paraphrase: The desire meaning records an urge taking hold of someone in impersonal prendre constructions.
items.contextualInference: Il me prend envie in unit 180 marks the arising of a desire, rather than acquiring strength.

items.paraphrase: Fantaisie can name desire or will and is used with impersonal prendre for an impulse that arises.
items.contextualInference: Later prit fantaisie in unit 186 must share the same onset-of-feeling prendre meaning.

items.paraphrase: A disease emporter someone means causing their death.
items.contextualInference: Hunger, fatigue and intemperance in unit 182 carry soldiers off in the death-causing meaning.

items.paraphrase: The phrase race humaine denotes human beings in general.
items.contextualInference: Unit 184 refers to humanity as a whole, not family ancestry or a subdivision of humans.
